finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_volume_coefficient_of_variation_20d
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The frozen Alpha158 design exposes VSTD20=Std(volume,20)/(current volume+1e-12) and VMA20=Mean(volume,20)/(current volume+1e-12). Their ratio cancels the shared current-volume normalization and measures the scale-free twenty-session coefficient of variation of daily volume. This is a within-stock multi-session participation-burstiness mechanism; it uses no price, return, peer rank, intraday clock profile, fitted model or return-selected parameter.

parameters.valid_input_rule: both inputs finite; VSTD20 nonnegative; VMA20 strictly positive; resulting ratio finite and nonnegative; never fill, clip, winsorize, threshold or add a new epsilon
parameters.economic_hypothesis: higher scale-free daily-volume burstiness represents episodic information arrival and attention concentration whose repricing may persist over the next three accepted sessions

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_volume_stability_inverse_20d
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: One divided by, one minus, or the lower direction of the selected coefficient would create a two-direction search rather than an independent mechanism.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_volume_coefficient_of_variation_horizon_grid
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Trying 5, 10, 30 or 60 sessions, averaging horizons or selecting a best horizon would create a horizon search. One conventional 20-session month is frozen before values.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_raw_vstd_or_vma_level
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Raw VSTD20 or VMA20 retains their shared current-volume normalization and does not isolate scale-free dispersion relative to the same-window mean.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_volume_cv_log_epsilon_clip_winsor_threshold_or_bucket_family
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Log transforms, extra epsilon, clipping, winsorization, thresholds and buckets add discretionary variants. The raw finite ratio is the only selected form.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_price_volume_or_volume_direction_mixture
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Mixing VSTD/VMA with WVMA, CORR, CORD, VSUMP, VSUMN, VSUMD, price momentum or price volatility would reopen price-volume confirmation and introduce component and weight choices already exhausted by Campaign295 and earlier terminal mechanisms.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: campaign295_296_or_297_retune_reverse_rehorizon_threshold_reweight_or_combination
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign295--297 are immutable and terminal. Their SUMD/CORD, BETA/RSQR and QTLU/QTLD/MAX/MIN definitions may not be inverted, re-horizoned, thresholded, reweighted, combined or otherwise rescued. The selected factor uses none of those inputs.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_peer_rank_state_consensus_extremity_persistence_or_horizon_geometry_refresh
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign290--294 already consumed the peer-state and cross-horizon geometry cluster. Campaign298 uses a raw within-stock twenty-session volume distribution ratio and no same-session peer transform.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_supervised_tree_mlp_kernel_hash_weight_subset_or_terminal_factor_combination_search
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign286--289 and earlier complete-library campaigns already consumed fitted and randomized model families. Campaign298 contains exactly one deterministic weight-1 factor, no terminal-factor combination and no training-return read.
